# Ihsan Solo Ads

> Ihsan Solo Ads is a premium solo ad email-traffic vendor founded in 2018, serving affiliate marketers in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. We sell unique-click email broadcasts to engaged Tier-1 subscribers with a verified 40%+ average opt-in rate.

## Quick facts

- **Service**: Solo ad email traffic (paid email broadcasts to opt-in subscribers)
- **Geography**: 90% Tier-1 traffic (US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand)
- **Average opt-in rate**: 40%+ on reviewed funnels
- **Overdelivery**: 10% extra clicks on every order
- **Guarantee**: Free additional clicks if a reviewed funnel returns under 30% opt-ins
- **Founded**: 2018
- **Founder**: Ihsan
- **Contact**: support@ihsansoloads.com
- **Website**: https://ihsansoloads.com

## Pricing

- **Starter** — 300 clicks for $100
- **Standard** — 600 clicks for $200 (most popular)
- **Premium** — 1,100 clicks for $300
- **Custom volume** — available on request via contact form

Every package includes professional swipe copywriting, real-time click tracking, 10% overdelivery, and the risk-free opt-in guarantee.

## Niches accepted

Make Money Online (MMO), business opportunities, affiliate marketing, crypto / trading education, weight loss & fitness, personal development, self-help / relationships, and email marketing tools.

Niches NOT accepted: B2B SaaS / enterprise, local services, luxury goods, CBD, gambling, adult content.

## Lead Agent (software)

Lead Agent is a browser extension sold by Ihsan Solo Ads for $299 one-time (lifetime access, 2 computers). It is an AI lead finder for marketing agencies, internet marketers, list builders and affiliate marketers.

- **Lead sources**: Google Maps (21 countries), LinkedIn and Sales Navigator (people and company searches and profiles the user opens; it never sends LinkedIn messages or connection requests), Yelp, YellowPages, custom directories, CSV import
- **Enrichment**: emails found on business websites with mail-domain checks, decision-maker finder, website problem audit, activity score from 0 to 100 (recent reviews, owner replies, claimed listing, live website, LinkedIn activity)
- **Live phone check** (optional, user's own Twilio, Veriphone or NumVerify account): valid number and line type; with Twilio, whether the line is in service
- **Outreach**: personal cold email campaigns from the user's own Gmail with warm-up, daily caps and one follow-up; AI first line per lead; replies sorted with AI-drafted answers that the user sends
- **AI comment assistant**: drafts comments for LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Reddit posts in the user's voice; the user presses Post
- **Autopilot**: daily saved searches, sending, reply checks every 15 minutes, CRM push, daily backup and a morning summary, while the computer and browser are on
- **Browsers**: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox 128+ (Windows, Mac, Linux)
- **Exports**: CSV/XLSX for Instantly, lemlist, Smartlead, Apollo, HubSpot; push to HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets, webhooks
- **Privacy**: leads are stored in the user's browser
- Page: [Lead Agent](https://ihsansoloads.com/lead-agent)

## Common questions answered on the site

- What is a solo ad? — A paid email broadcast where you pay a list owner to email their subscribers your link.
- How long does delivery take? — Most campaigns start within 24 hours; full delivery in 2–4 days.
- What opt-in rate should I expect? — 30–45% on a tight, focused squeeze page on Tier-1 traffic.
- Is there a guarantee? — Yes, under 30% opt-ins on a pre-reviewed funnel triggers free additional clicks.
- Do you provide tracking? — Yes, traffic flows through tracking links compatible with ClickMagick, Improvely and similar tools.
